title: Progress in immunization information systems--United States, 2011.
ehr_evidence: To monitor progress toward achieving these and other program goals, CDC annually surveys 56 immunization program grantees using the IIS Annual Report (IISAR).
summary: A 2011 cross-sectional surveillance report analysing immunization information system (IIS) participation and core data-element completeness among U.S. children aged <6 years using IIS Annual Report data.
key_findings: In 2011, 84% (19.2 million) of U.S. children aged <6 years participated in an IIS, an increase from 82% (18.8 million) in 2010.
Completeness of vaccine manufacturer data was 63% and vaccine lot number was 60% in 2011.
Average completeness of NVAC core data elements ranged from 38% (mother's middle name) to ≥98% for six fields.
Among 54 grantees reporting in 2011, 32 (59%) included a field for each of the 18 data elements.
limitations: IISAR data were self-reported and self-validated.
Nationwide participation rates and core data-element completeness might be underestimated or overestimated because two of 56 grantees did not report.
